name: MJSFX
soft_passes: #1 inset panel's rounded corners echo the system squircle (concentric double-radius) — risks a bezel/corner-radius mismatch at Dock size
#3 silhouette is a thin line not a mass; reads as 'sine wave' by gesture, leans on cyan-on-dark contrast rather than shape mass
#4 ~4% stroke thins to ~0.6px at 16px but the single big S-gesture spanning the tile survives; baseline + panel inset vanish harmlessly
#5 flat = no light model; trivially consistent (nothing conflicts) but the absence of lighting/depth is why it reads as a flat web/brand mark
failures: #10 cyan #00E0FF glyph is background-dependent (dark-locked, no authored light variant, not Icon Composer layers) — washes toward low contrast on a light/clear render

palette.background: two-tone inset panel: bezel field #191C20 around darker screen panel #0D0F12 (flat, no ramp); baseline hairline #1B1F24

light_model: none — uniformly flat fill, no gradient, no specular, no baked shadow; only depth cue is the tonal two-tone panel inset (bezel vs screen), not a lit surface
devices: oscilloscope screen — dark inset panel framed by a lighter bezel (framed-window motif applied literally to waveform editing)
single-cycle sine wave with rounded stroke caps, near-full-bleed
monochrome-cyan-on-near-black instrument palette; accent saturation reserved entirely for the glyph
rhymes_hint: dark terminal/developer-tool glyph icons (single luminous accent glyph on near-black, no Big Sur material — Ghostty/iTerm-adjacent) and minimalist audio-utility/oscilloscope-app icons that draw the subject as a scope trace
notes: Resolution: 600x600 web render, not a 1024 master; simple geometry survives downscale. Slight near-white anti-alias fringing on the cyan lower trough is a resize/compression artifact, NOT a design specular. Stroke width ~24px @600 (~4% canvas), estimated (vertical scan overreads near peaks). Strong icon<->cover brand coherence: same cyan hue family (icon #00E0FF, cover 'bleep'/label #2EC6DA) on same near-black ground (#181B1F/#0C0F11), monospace 8-bit branding; the icon mark is reproduced in the cover header logo. Key finding for synthesis: a fully flat, dark-locked accent-glyph icon that entirely sidesteps both Big Sur material conventions and the current Liquid Glass layer system — committed terminal/instrument direction, but non-native to macOS 26's icon language. Do NOT feed the flat/no-light model into native macOS icon canon; record it as an indie-brand-mark counter-example.
